summary: Recon freezes 41 canonical world/city/project/skill identities, 29 evidence-confirmed but spatially unplaced city-local skill instances, a tracer coordinate frame, a shared prompt/style bible, four gated production batches, and a blocker-based art-QA rubric. Six ACE Hardware and Column Technologies project identities remain evidence-held; no architecture, skill mapping, or technical symbolism may be invented for them.

canonical_asset_taxonomy.identity_rule: world, city, project, and skill IDs are canonical definitions; instance IDs own placement and employer palette. LOD and UI-support assets never create replacement identities.

lod.contract: LOD may add doors, windows, roof equipment, secondary strokes, and approved ambient attachments. It may not change footprint, centroid, orientation, primary mass, roofline, facade rhythm, sign position, or palette-slot assignment.

excluded_mock_or_example_residue.reason: Java and AI appear only as suggested/example IDs, engineering-reporting appears only in an obsolete mock, and data-quality resolves to the confirmed skill/data-contracts@v1 identity.

visible_skill_recommendation.verdict: Use all 19 current evidence graph nodes as canonical visible skill definitions. Preserve node kind as capability or technology; do not create IDs from mock labels or asset-map examples.

uncertain.ace_hardware: No named skill asset or project-skill link is supportable from approved evidence.
uncertain.column_technologies: No named skill asset or project-skill link is supportable from approved evidence.

unplaced.meaning: Employer associations and instance IDs are confirmed, but exact city-local x/y/orientation values depend on accepted asset footprints and the CW-003 collision pass.
unplaced.visibility: Skill coordinates remain fixed in the city registry. Skills are hidden at employer level and only the selected project's linked instances are revealed at project focus.

tracer_coordinates.authority: Coordinates must live in deterministic registries and never be inferred from generated pixels.

ninjaone_tracer_city_space.dependency: All remaining city-local skill positions stay unset until canonical footprint envelopes exist. Freeze capital, then projects, then unique skill pads, then roads, then ambient props; never fit geometry to an image-generated city.

shared_prompt_style_bible.future_generation_mode: Built-in image generation only in later packets, one call per distinct asset or deliberate variant. Concepts are tracing/review references, never final geometry.
shared_prompt: Scene/backdrop: isolated asset on a near-black navy technical drafting field with a faint isometric grid and generous margin.
Subject: one named canonical identity only, using its inventory ID and asset-specific architecture brief.
Style/medium: restrained technical-cartography line art, matte low-value faces, thin parallel strokes, minimal bloom, no perspective convergence.
Composition/framing: locked orthographic camera; LOD-0, LOD-1, LOD-2, and one solid silhouette inset are separated and unobscured.
Lighting/mood: fixed graphic face values, quiet and legible, not cinematic.
Text: none; IDs, labels, and approved glyphs are code-native and added after geometry acceptance.
Constraints: same footprint, centroid, orientation, primary masses, roofline, facade rhythm, and sign-slot anchor in every LOD panel.
Avoid: logos, mascots, logo cubes, pseudo-text, watermark, PBR, photorealism, cyberpunk, fantasy, graph/dashboard nodes, private details, unsupported numbers, and new objects between LODs.

materials_and_lines.material: matte technical-cartography faces; no glass, chrome, PBR, or cast shadows
materials_and_lines.face_rule: top=structure.base; lit side=base mixed toward line.secondary; shadow side=structure.shadow
materials_and_lines.emissive_budget: at most 3 percent of visible building-face area

density.world: Capital silhouette at most 5 percent viewport height; built forms at most 18 percent of land area; ambient at most 8 percent.
density.employer: Show capital and projects; keep skill instances fixed but hidden. Built geometry at most 28 percent; at least 35 percent negative space.
density.project: Selected project occupies 14-20 percent of viewport; linked skills 4-8 percent each; no coordinate changes.
density.labels: At most seven persistent labels; all exact text code-native.

easter_eggs: LOD-2 decorative attachment only; never changes silhouette, footprint, identity, evidence, or required interaction.
At most one active per project focus and three visible decorative attachments per viewport.
Public-safe approved references only; no ACE/Column project eggs until evidence holds clear.
Animation stops under reduced motion and never encodes a metric, proficiency, traffic, or runtime direction.
shared_prompt_style_bible.brand_rule: Do not ask an image model to draw employer or technology marks. If approved, mechanically normalized code-native vectors occupy the fixed sign slot after architecture acceptance.

non_generation_gates: Render skill/go@v1 from one geometry in NinjaOne, Tanium, and Independent palettes and compare geometry hashes.

art_qa_rubric.score: Rate each criterion 0-4; weighted score is sum(weight * rating / 4). Promote at 90 or higher with no blocker and no critical criterion below 3. Revise at 80-89. Reject below 80 or on any blocker.

criteria.check: Silhouette IoU at least 0.98; centroid drift at most 0.5 percent width; footprint, orientation, masses, roofline, facade rhythm, and sign slot unchanged.
Ground axes within 1 degree, verticals within 0.5 degree, no convergence or alternate north.
Identical geometry hash across employer variants; palette and placement are the only differences; one instance per employer-skill pair.
No unsupported architecture claim, private detail, metric implication, generated mark, real campus, or ACE/Column symbolism.
No melted joins, impossible stairs/windows, disconnected masses, tangencies, inconsistent axes, or silhouette-changing props.
Technical cartography, not generic AI concept art, PBR, neon cyberpunk, graph dashboard, logo plinth, or fantasy.
Only secondary detail changes; primary-edge jump at most 1.5 percent asset diagonal in alpha overlay.
Eight slots present, emissive area at most 3 percent, no baked employer color in reusable geometry.
Meets density and negative-space budgets; no label collision; readable at target thumbnail.
Isolated, complete, watermark-free, and rebuildable as deterministic vector/code geometry without guessing hidden edges.

automatic_blockers: Primary geometry, orientation, coordinates, or camera change across zoom/LOD
Independent image-generated employer recolors of a reusable skill
Duplicate skill instance in one employer city
Unsupported ACE/Column architecture, skill, link, or easter egg
Private identifier, unsupported number, pseudo-text, watermark, generated logo, system-tour/video residue
Photorealistic/PBR, graph/dashboard, logo-cube, perspective, or non-extractable scene
required_review_artifacts: mechanical palette-reuse contact sheet and geometry hash
art_qa_rubric.generic_ai_failure_test: If identity depends on a logo, text, neon glyph, oversized prop, or prompt explanation rather than silhouette and massing, reject it as generic.
